name: DPS
tagline: Diffusion Posterior Sampling: gradient-of-likelihood guidance applied to the predicted clean signal at every reverse step.
diff_from_baseline: Chung et al. 2023 (ICLR). Score-based posterior sampling that adds the gradient of the measurement log-likelihood at each reverse-diffusion step. Standard reference for differentiable forward operators.

name: LGD (Loss-Guided Diffusion)
tagline: Replaces DPS's deterministic gradient with a Monte-Carlo average over noisy samples around the denoised estimate.
diff_from_baseline: Song et al. 2023 (NeurIPS). Loss-Guided Diffusion: Monte-Carlo expectation of the measurement gradient under the diffusion posterior, reducing variance versus DPS for non-differentiable or noisy losses.

name: REDDiff
tagline: Optimization-based reconstruction: Adam updates a clean-image variable with diffusion-denoised regularization plus a measurement-fidelity term.
diff_from_baseline: Mardani et al. 2023 (NeurIPS). Regularization-by-Denoising with diffusion priors: optimizes a clean-image variable with Adam, using the diffusion score as a denoising regularizer rather than running a reverse SDE.
